why: This is a released research dataset and accompanying evaluation framework, not a reusable instructional element or an education-specific research method.

why: This is a study-specific multimodal learning-analytics method for estimating attention from fused EEG–fNIRS signals, not a general theory of learning.

why: Educational escape rooms are an instructional method or activity format, not a general explanatory theory of learning, a specific implementation, a named product, or a research method.

name: Six patterns of theoretical integration in EER research

why: The candidate is a structured debriefing practice after an experience, so its implementation details and limited evidence belong on the canonical Debriefing principle page.

why: This is a study-specific EEG operationalization of internal attention rather than a general learning theory, and it does not establish a reusable theory beyond the existing cognitive and information-processing accounts.

name: EER-Tutor

why: This is an education-specific framework for coding and grouping trial-level explanatory variables in subgroup meta-analyses, not a general theory of learning.
name: Five-theme theoretical framework for grouping explanatory variables in meta-analyses of intervention trial effect sizes

why: EETAM is a study-specific instructional sequence combining Toulmin argumentation with explicit epistemological-belief discussion in one seventh-grade science unit, not a general learning theory or reusable programme.
